title: Dejan's Dixie boat band and drummer Judge; request to play
summary: Dejan tells how Judge got on the Dixie boat band, then Purnell is asked to play a piece and agrees.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: When I went on the Dixie, we used to have a contest. Every 17 days, this band used to have a little band around here, they called it Alley Cat. And why was it Duke Deja on this Dixieland serenade? Well, we didn't have no drum on the boat, see? Well, Judge always did play with me, you know, the job and he wasn't doing nothing. Well, that was my side drummer, you know? So, when we hit time, somebody said, well, you know something. You know Judge been playing with Harold around here. The Judge is not on that boat because they're not using no drum on that boat. He said, but Harold will have a judge. I'm going to be sorry. And before I step through, I was just running through that. That guy used to... Oh, that boy could play a something.

He likes it, too. Yeah. They bass, too, you know. Yeah. Just a couple of more minutes on here. You wanted to hear Pedro play a piece. If it feels like it... It's not a Sunday style. How you feel like it? Yeah, I guess I can.
